title: J Rodriguez shares a new single "Gucci Sex"
htmlContent:
London-based singer and songwriterJ Rodriguez has released a new single called "Gucci Sex," a supreme music that you can hit play on and be a fan of the art. The music sounds just as good as it feels to hear, to make sure it will last the times for us all to keep coming back to hear the masterpiece that was created to make the world feel the magic when we need it most. For the major record you get a vocal performance that shines through it all to make you enjoy the fresh life that is put into the music in a real way.

J Rodriguez is a supreme lyricist, who has incredible lyricism on every track, including his latest release. His wordplay is beyond crazy, with metaphors that he plays with at will, as if he was on a remote hitting A, B, B, C to deliver a knockout blow on the competition. His powerful delivery to the fullest, and makes you feel the music more as he’s impossible to ignore, on this top grade record.
